data.body: Added config-driven version-file exemption (DD3a + DD7 + E-version): the shared exemption helper rc_diff_is_exempt_only reads version.file_path from dso config (host-inheritable; supports .json/.toml/plaintext), exempting version-file-only commits from per-SHA coverage so an un-provenanced version bump or rebase-resolved version-conflict commit cannot trigger llm-review re-review. Diff-scoped (mixed version+code NOT exempt). Sourced from one config key shared with the story-6 allowlist.
